Certifications, regulations, and standards
We maintain strict standards for security, privacy, and operational integrity, validated through independent audits and internationally recognized certifications.
ISO/IEC 27001
The internationally recognized standard that specifies requirements for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving an Information Security Management System (ISMS).
ISO/IEC 27017
Provides guidelines for information security controls specifically relevant to cloud service providers and cloud service customers.
ISO/IEC 27018
Establishes controls and best practices for protecting Personally Identifiable Information (PII) in public cloud environments, based on the privacy principles of ISO/IEC 29100.
ISO/IEC 27701
Extends ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 27002 to include a Privacy Information Management System (PIMS), helping organizations manage personal data privacy.
SOC 2
A comprehensive, regularly updated report that evaluates our controls related to security, availability, confidentiality, and privacy.
